args.query:
-- Calculate statistics for IQR method
SELECT 
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    CASE 
        WHEN cognitive_score >= (SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score ASC LIMIT 8)
        THEN 'possibly low outlier'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END as cognitive_status,
    CASE 
        WHEN reaction_ms >= (SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements ORDER BY reaction_ms DESC LIMIT 4)
        THEN 'possibly reaction outlier'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END as reaction_status
FROM measurements;

-- Calculate quartiles for cognitive_score
WITH ordered_scores AS (
    SELECT cognitive_score FROM measurements ORDER BY cognitive_score ASC
),
quartiles AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM ordered_scores LIMIT 7 OFFSET 0) as Q1,  -- 7th value (approx 27/4)
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM ordered_scores LIMIT 14 OFFSET 0) as MEDIAN,
        (SELECT cognitive_score FROM ordered_scores LIMIT 22) as Q3
)
SELECT Q1, MEDIAN, Q3 FROM quartiles;

-- Simple threshold-based outlier detection
-- Based on visual inspection and statistical outliers:
-- cognitive_score: values < 10 are outliers (3, 4, 5)
-- reaction_ms: values > 1000 are outliers (1180, 1200, 1250)

-- Check which records would be excluded
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_rt
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    CASE 
        WHEN cognitive_score < 15 THEN 'EXCLUDE - low cognitive'
        WHEN reaction_ms > 800 THEN 'EXCLUDE - high reaction'
        ELSE 'KEEP'
    END as status
FROM measurements
ORDER BY cognitive_score, reaction_ms DESC;

-- Create cleaned_measurements table excluding outliers
-- Outliers: cognitive_score < 15 OR reaction_ms > 800

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score >= 15 
  AND reaction_ms <= 800;

-- Verify the creation
SELECT COUNT(*) as cleaned_count FROM cleaned_measurements;
